chunks: As for what Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, who said:
I asked him about a man who performed tawaf around the House and became fatigued: may he delay the tawaf between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until tomorrow? He said: No.

So this does not conflict with the first two reports, because the concession in the two reports only came regarding delaying the saʿy for an hour or two. But as for delaying it until the next day, it is not permissible, according to what the last report contains.

key_terms.الطَّوَافَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: the ritual saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.سَاعَةً أَوْ سَاعَتَيْنِ: for one hour or two hours

ai.seo_question: Can a person delay the saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah until the next day after tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah after tawaf in hajj or ʿumrah. It indicates that a brief delay due to fatigue may be allowed, but postponing the saʿy until the next day is not permissible.
